description: Defines the MediaDrmMetrics class which captures various DRM-related metrics within MediaDrm, including counters and event metrics, and provides methods for exporting metrics and managing session data.

classes.name: MediaDrmMetrics
classes.description: Class for capturing and exporting DRM metrics, including session counts, timing, and status events.

methods.name: SetSessionStart
methods.description: Records the start time of a session.

methods.name: SetSessionEnd
methods.description: Records the end time of a session.

methods.name: SetAppPackageName
methods.description: Sets the application package name using the provided String8.

methods.name: GetAppPackageName
methods.description: Returns the stored application package name.

methods.name: GetSerializedMetrics
methods.description: Serializes and retrieves all metrics; returns error status if serialization fails.

methods.name: GetSessionLifespans
methods.description: Returns a copy of session lifespan data.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeMs
methods.description: Returns current time in milliseconds; visible for testing.
